title: Binance Will List Alchemix (ALCX)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Alchemix (ALCX) and will open trading for ALCX/BTC, ALCX/BUSD, and ALCX/USDT trading pairs at 2021-11-30 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  ALCX  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for ALCX will open at 2021-12-01 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Alchemix (ALCX)? Alchemix is a DeFi protocol that allows for the creation of synthetic tokens that represent the future yield of a deposit. ALCX is the native token of Alchemix and is used for protocol governance and liquidity mining. ALCX Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
